mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of interaction instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 for interaction signal over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month industrial production decline below 100 signals manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate profits and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days during supply-driven recessions.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >55% of supply-driven recession instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payroll growth above 100,000 per month indicates labor market strength, supporting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances when PAYEMS > 100,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating inflation, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly GDP contraction (GDPC1 < 0) and housing starts decline (HOUST < 0) indicate severe economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >55% of interaction instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 for interaction signal over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle labor markets (UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS growth < 50,000), a sudden payroll deceleration signals labor market peak, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of late-cycle labor market peak instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
